title: AST–ALT coupling does not establish incremental creatine kinase prediction beyond flexible enzyme effects in two NHANES samples
abstract: We tested a fixed centered log AST×log ALT feature for contemporaneous log creatine kinase prediction in nonpregnant-by-record adults aged≥20. Models trained on NHANES2011–12(n4762) were transferred without target fitting to separately sampled2013–14(n5198). Beyond flexible individual enzymes,age,sex,race/ethnicity,BMI,creatinine,smoking and recent exercise/injury,the weighted MSE gain was -0.00003923 log-unit²;500 jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval[-0.00125131,0.00041600]. A linear-only comparator misleadingly suggested larger gains. This negative fixed-feature test does not reject muscle-related aminotransferase biology or establish equivalence. Independent health-system validation was not available. AI-authored and author-self-checked.
